reviews.name: Fahim Falzada
reviews.text: I did the Iceland (fire & ice) trip with some of the most amazing people around. The trip was fantastic and the itinerary was full of surprises. From incredible hikes in the mountains to chasing waterfalls and relaxing in hot springs, there is nothing else like it. It is truly a blessing to have professionals plan the entire trip, so that I could turn off my mind and simply enjoy being present. I was in good company with the leaders, who organized and worked hard around the clock to make sure we all had an excellent experience. It takes a lot of work and skill to run these trips and the leaders at SYB are absolute pros who are dedicated to the craft. Look no further; this is it. You will remember your experience forever and might get hooked to go again and again. Thank you SYB for making the world a better place!

reviews.name: Samantha Donovan
reviews.text: What an absolutely amazing trip!!! I just returned from Iceland and it was a trip of a lifetime. We were spoiled with the sunshine, rainbows, hikes, workouts, puffins, northern lights and most important the best people. Eli, Christian and Meag as leaders made the experience even better. Each day they were hyping us up for our adventure, leading the way, capturing the most beautiful photos. Highly recommend the three of them as your next leaders! Thanks SYB - can’t wait for the next trip!

reviews.name: Ryan Pitts
reviews.text:
My SYB Iceland trip was an absolutely unforgettable experience! From start to finish, the trip was filled with great vibes, amazing people, and incredible experiences.

A huge shoutout to our leaders Meag, Christian, and Eli for making the trip so special. They brought such great energy, made everyone feel included, and did an awesome job keeping the group connected and having fun. You could tell they genuinely cared about everyone having a great experience.

The itinerary was incredible — we got to see some of the most beautiful landscapes Iceland has to offer, experience the Northern Lights, take amazing photos, do a cold plunge, and somehow even fit in fun and games, trampolines, and plenty of laughs along the way. There was always something going on, but it never felt overwhelming.

The combination of the scenery, adventures, people, and overall atmosphere made this trip something I’ll remember for a long time. I came home with some incredible photos and even better memories.

10/10 would do it again. If you’re thinking about booking an SYB trip, do it!

reviews.name: Bart Fuchs
reviews.text: Best group travel around. If you want to not worry about where to go while traveling join this amazing group. My trip to Iceland would not have been half as fun and rewarding if not for these amazing people leading the way and taking us to the best hiking spots and hot springs in record time. If you want to travel and get stuff done in a short amount of time while making incredible friends along the way, it’s worth the money. Take the leap!!

reviews.name: Amber S.
reviews.text:
Just completed my 1st SYB trip in Iceland, and it'll be a tough one to beat! I’ve traveled solo and abroad with friends, but this was my first time joining group travel. I wasn’t totally sure what to expect going in, but the experience exceeded my expectations. Everyone was so friendly and welcoming, and I genuinely couldn’t have asked for a better group.

Our leaders, Meag, Christian, and Eli, were the perfect mix of fun, energetic, and encouraging. They kept us motivated, grounded when needed, and laughing throughout the trip.

We somehow managed to get incredible weather all week! The hikes were challenging, the views were UNREAL, and we even got a little Northern Lights action. I came home with a shorter bucket list, and made some unforgettable memories along the way.

The accommodations were clean, comfortable, convenient, and the whole trip was well organized.

I’d absolutely recommend SYB to anyone looking to see the world, push themselves a little, and connect with some awesome people along the way. I’m already looking forward to my next adventure and hope to maybe run into some familiar faces!

reviews.name: Kelsey Rudzinsky
reviews.text:
I just got back from my first SYB trip, I went to Iceland. Truly, a 10/10 trip. This company is the real deal. I felt safe, supported, and excited for more the entire week. Eli was the trip leader and he is one of the most wonderful humans I have met! Eli, Meag, and Christian were the perfect balance and it was clear they put so much energy and intention into making the entire week as incredible as it was.

As someone who doesn’t really drink, I was nervous going in that I’d feel left out. I didn’t. The people who go on these trips are definitely the work hard, play hard type- but they are welcoming and accepting of all. The physicality of the trip exceeded my expectations. I felt pushed and challenged by the hikes. The accommodations were clean and safe- and it was really fun to share a room with 6 people- it felt like being at summer camp.

I definitely plan on doing another SYB trip, and if you’re looking for a fun group trip to go on- I recommend this company for sure!

reviews.name: Elvis
reviews.text: SYB Iceland (Iceland North, Twice the Ice) was incredible! The hikes they chose had spectacular scenery while also delivering on being physically challenging enough to make you feel like you truly accomplished something when reaching a summit. The trip was meticulously researched by the guides - they knew the hikes and logistics, and just as important, they knew where to go for the best meals and lagoons (hot springs). As if all of that weren’t enough, there were these special moments of guided reflection as well (mental yoga!) that deepened the experience even further. Highly recommend this.

reviews.name: Sierra Vigna
reviews.text:
UPDATE: Travelled for a third time with SYB to Iceland and it was the best decision I ever made. My favourite thing about these trips is that I book it and don't have to think twice about itinerary or planning for a second - I just show up and SYB shows me the time of my life. Meag, Christian and Eli - the amazing leaders who show up for everyone and really are the glue that holds the whole thing together - thank you SO MUCH for all of your effort and for being incredible humans and guiding us through this unbelievable trip. I'll probably have to edit this review again in a few months because I'm not done travelling with SYB!

Just came back from my second trip with SYB - the Nicaragua trip was incredibly fun and I felt zero stress the entire time I was there. Holly, Matas and Luke were the coolest leaders and kept everything organized while also having a blast alongside our group. 10/10 recommend traveling this way - good for the soul. 🩷

reviews.name: Gianna Cassio
reviews.text: Just got back from a trip to Italy and hiking the Dolomites + a boat day on Lake Garda! Hands down one of the best trips I've ever taken! Wild to think I didn't know the other 43 people going into this trip and now we are all good friends. Our guides Alex, Lauren, Eli, Aaron, and Christina were all fantastic! The hiking was incredible, the food was delicious, and the conversations warmed the soul. This was my first time to Europe and I want to travel more, but not quite solo yet, and this was a great way to do it. I'm already planning on booking my next one with them (Iceland 2.0)!  I highly recommend taking a trip with Surf Yoga Beer!

reviews.name: Timothy Dunn
reviews.text:
My first Surf Yoga Beer trip was Iceland in 2025, and since then I’ve been back again and again: Croatia, the Dolomites, Val Thorens, the Amalfi Coast, and the South of France. I think that says more than any review ever could.

Every trip has been completely different, but one thing has remained consistent: exceptional people, outstanding leadership, and experiences that exceed every expectation. Mantas, Bradford, Eli, Steph, and the entire SYB team have built something that’s incredibly difficult to replicate. They don’t just organize trips—they create an environment where strangers quickly become friends and unforgettable memories happen naturally.

The itineraries are always excellent, but they’re honestly the least important part of the experience. What makes Surf Yoga Beer special is the community. The people you meet, the friendships you build, and the moments that happen between the planned activities are what keep me coming back.

After six trips, I can confidently say this is one of the best decisions I’ve ever made for travel. If you’re on the fence, stop overthinking it. Book the trip. You’ll understand why so many people come back year after year.

reviews.name: Lively X
reviews.text: SYB Iceland has been hands down 1 of my favorite trips! I’ve traveled to so many countries but this was extra special. I loved all the challenging hikes & fitness guru that will rock with you at a fast pace. I meet such incredible humans that I can’t wait to spend more time with after the trip. The leads were absolutely phenomenal with positive energy & attention to creating the most valuable experience for everyone. If you are looking to book don’t hesitate- Just DO!

reviews.name: Ally M
reviews.text:
ICELAND 2025 — I had never done anything like SYB before and honestly, I was nervous leading up to it. But within 24 hours, I met my West Coast twin and bestie (literally everyone thought we booked the trip together). Not even 36 hours in everyone already felt like fam.

This trip pushed me physically and sometimes mentally but also filled my heart with the kind of joy you only get when you’re surrounded by new best friends. Bradford and Eli were the absolute dream team, leading with energy, care, and nonstop support. You could feel how much effort they poured into making sure we were safe, challenged, and having the time of our lives.

If you’re looking for movement, connection, and magic this is it. I’m so lucky to be leaving with new friends… and even luckier that we’ve already planned our next trips together. 🖤✨

reviews.name: Dariya Kizieieva
reviews.text: My Iceland trip was my first SYB experience, and it certainly won't be my last! I had the best time exploring this beautiful country with a group of incredible people I can now call friends. We did lots of scenic hikes, runs, themed parties, and recovery in hot springs & Blue Lagoon! The leaders had amazing energy and a natural talent for bringing people together and empowering them to go for fitness challenges they were afraid to do before, celebrating everyone along the way. This trip was one for the books & a true adventure of a lifetime!

reviews.name: Hari Devanathan
reviews.text:
Even in the summer, Iceland weather is very unpredictable. We were very lucky to have little to no rain during our 6 day trip.

Nevertheless, I’m confident that Surf Yoga Beer is extremely well informed about Iceland that they could pivot to other activities in inclement weather and still make the trip an exhilarating experience. Bradford and Eli were excellent tour guides who made this trip physically challenging, yet extremely rewarding. While it’s targeted for people of all fitness levels (and you can opt out of activities if they are too hard), I will say that training yourself in fit shape will help you explore and hike all the wonders that Iceland has to offer.

I’ve had friends recommend that I travel to Iceland with a group of friends where we rent a car and drive around the country. While that is a cheaper option than the package Surf Yoga Beer offers, I doubt myself (and other friends) would be able to plan a detailed, well thought out trip as well as Surf Yoga Beer did. All of my friends who did Iceland admitted they never hiked one of its famous trails (Fiimmvorouhals), or they hiked half of it. Surf Yoga beer planned an overnight hike where we trekked 16 miles to see incredible views shown below. It’s not easy to plan such an expedition for a large group of various fitness levels, yet they pulled it off.

Thanks to Surf Yoga Beer, Bradford, and Eli for the memories and challenges! Iceland was fantastic thanks to your guidance!

reviews.name: Liz Hornberger
reviews.text: To say the SYB Iceland 2025 trip was fun and well worth the money would be a drastic understatement. This trip (and the people I met) has been the highlight of the last few years. It gave me exactly what I was looking for - a way to travel the world, feel/stay safe, meet new people, be challenged physically and work out while vacationing, and grow as a person. The team leaders (Bradford and Eli) are two of the most genuine, selfless, and fun people I’ve ever traveled with, and I can say that I would follow them to the world’s end….. because we basically did that on an intense 16-mile hike into the mountains through snow, dried lava, and forestry. If anything, the worst part of the whole thing is that it was so much fun that I now have to book another trip. I am so happy I took a chance and booked this trip, and I cannot wait for the next one.

reviews.name: Tyler Signora
reviews.text: SYB Iceland ‘25 was my first SYB trip and my first time traveling in a group format. It exceeded every expectation. The leaders cultivated the perfect week and sense of community. The people are all there for the same reason, to meet new people and experience new adventures. Couldn’t recommend SYB more.

reviews.name: Maude Sestier
reviews.text:
Iceland with Surf Yoga Beer was magic.
I came solo, unsure what to expect and left five days later with a full heart, sore muscles, and a whole new crew of people who feel like family.

We hiked, pushed ourselves, laughed nonstop, and somehow had the best weather. It started out a little scary, but the warmth, openness, and love from this group made it feel safe so fast.

The Games of Thrones theme party was the funniest thing ever - everyone took their costumes very seriously and it was awesome. #HouseOfMidgard

I’ll never forget this experience. Truly one of the most powerful trips I’ve ever taken.

reviews.name: Emily Dowd
reviews.text: SYB Iceland pushed me beyond my limits in the best way. Booking a solo trip can be scary - but the group leaders Bradford & Eli were so welcoming from the beginning with every single person in the group. The people were  fantastic and I have made lasting new friendships ❤️ Lifechanging trip - book it to grow yourself in every way

reviews.name: Dom Clifford
reviews.text:
SYB Iceland was something else - the most fulfiling week for the mind and body.

Everyone in the group bought the most contagious energy and we pushed the boundaries. It past all expectations and some.

Thanks to everyone for making it happen, especially our viking leaders Bradford and Eli showing us the way.

Dom

reviews.name: Kayla Nelson
reviews.text: My first SYB trip was to Iceland with Bradford and Eli. What an amazing, life changing experience! We had 5 well curated, jam packed days, with an awesome group of like minded people. I’m not sure I could travel with a group again because it might not live up to this trip. Specifically, they did a great job choosing the hikes, the things we saw, we had a great hostel, and they did a great job encouraging people to get to know each other. This was a trip of many firsts, challenging what I thought I was capable of, and new friendships. I am leaving feeling energized and inspired!

reviews.name: Eric Watson
reviews.text: Absolutely unforgettable experience. The SurfYogaBeer Iceland trip blew me away. Eli and Bradford were incredible guides—striking the perfect balance between energizing workouts, local knowledge, and keeping our crew of 31 effortlessly organized across epic adventures. The sights? Mind-blowing. Each waterfall, volcano, and mountain seemed to top the last. Tons of physical activity, but always optional and pressure-free. I’ve traveled solo before, but this wouldn’t have been nearly the same without Eli and Bradford’s experience leading group trips like this. The camaraderie among 30 strangers turned friends? Pure magic.

reviews.name: Jenann Pham
reviews.text: If you’re thinking about booking the trip, “don’t think, just do” Bradford and Eli are the best group leaders you could ask for. They were enthusiastic, knowledgeable, and genuinely some of the best humans you’ll ever meet. My expectations with SYB were exceeded in Iceland! Our schedule was packed with adventures including hot springs, waterfalls, yoga, trail running, once in a lifetime hikes and of course Friendship. Bradford and Eli were able to cater to different preferences and fitness levels for the activities which made all the difference. I am forever thankful and can’t wait for my next SYB trip!

reviews.name: Stephanie Curtis
reviews.text: Syb iceland is amazing. The scenery is unreal, the vibes are epic, and the hikes will leave you feeling the best combination of accomplishment and awe! 😍 what better way to enjoy these incredible adventures than with a wonderful group of like-minded activity enthusiasts! SYB2025💙

reviews.name: Jith Eswarappa
reviews.text: I recently came back to Iceland with SYB for the second time because the first trip was so good, and found that it has only gotten better with time! Epic hikes, an incredible self-selecting group of like-minded travel companions, and trip leaders who are not just top notch organizers, trainers, and guides but preternaturally talented photographers and empaths who found the time to connect with everyone on the trip on a deep personal level. I cannot recommend it enough. If you’re somehow still on the fence about booking a trip, you need to live by the SYB motto, “Don’t think, just do!”

reviews.name: Roy Wang
reviews.text: Great experience with SYB Iceland trip (went in July 2025), definitely recommend!

reviews.name: Courtney Loomis
reviews.text:
5 stars all around for the SYB Iceland Fire & Ice Trip! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

This was my very first SYB adventure, and let me tell you—it blew my expectations out of the water! I went in eager to explore Iceland (a bucket list item, check! ✅), do some epic hikes, check out glaciers and waterfalls, and maybe make a friend or two along the way. Well, spoiler alert: this trip went above and beyond in so many ways! Not only did I get the adventure of a lifetime without having to plan a single thing (huge win), but I left with 40 new friends and unforgettable memories.

Our fearless leader Bradford and the dynamic photography duo, Eli & Brianna, brought next-level energy right from the start—and never let up! They're absolute pros at not only capturing breathtaking moments but also creating those magical human connections that make a trip unforgettable. Their vibes were a huge reason why this experience felt like one big adventure-packed family reunion!

If you're all about adventure, love traveling, care about fitness, and like to mix a good workout with an even better time, I can't recommend SYB enough! Whether it's your first trip or your tenth, trust me—you'll come back with way more than just stories and selfies.

reviews.name: Jordan Jackson
reviews.text: Don't overthink, just book! This was my first solo group travel experience, and I'm so happy I went with Surf Yoga Beer. From the moment we exited the plane, the leaders were so welcoming. Each day was planned out in detail, so you can just sit back, or rather hike up, all the mountains and waterfalls, and enjoy all the beauty Iceland has to offer. The photographers were so talented, allowing you to detach from your phone and connect with nature and each other. Every activity had varying levels of fitness intensity, so if you aren't in peak shape, don't talk yourself out of this! The hostel was clean, comfortable, and the staff made us feel at home. But most importantly, the people you will meet takes this experience to another level. From the leaders to the Surf Yoga Beer vets to the first timers, everyone radiated positivity and inclusiveness. Even a month after being home, our Iceland group is still chatting away, meeting up for workouts, enjoying the occasional bev, and even planning future travel adventures. I am so grateful for the experience and if you have any hesitations, don't think, just book!

reviews.name: Coral Abreu
reviews.text: Iceland was my first trip with SYB and for sure wont be my last. Everything was planned and had backups, it was so easy to be at ease. Our Leader Bradford was incredible, specially how he made 40 strangers feel connected. Our photographers Eli and Bri did an amazing job capturing every moment. Every day was well balanced with a physical activity, mindfulness and of course some healthy fun. 1000% would recommend for any solo travel.

reviews.name: Kayla Guerin
reviews.text:
Traveling through Iceland with my new SYB friends was an unforgettable adventure! Exploring waterfalls, hiking up breathtaking mountains, running with amazing people, and soaking in hot springs was absolutely incredible. Each workout ended with a giant celebration, turning every accomplishment into a joyous festivity. It was the perfect blend of adventure and fun, making every moment memorable.

One of the most challenging parts of the trip ended up being one of my favorite memories. We ran through the rain and were battling 40mph winds. Yet, there I was, drenched and laughing, with the wind howling around us. It was wild, exhilarating, and somehow perfectly unforgettable....and the waterfall at the end of the run was BEAUTIFUL.

Bradford, Bri, and Eli led us with such enthusiasm and spirit; their guidance made every moment magical and exhilarating. It was truly the ultimate experience, filled with laughter and discovery.

I cannot say enough good things about Surf Yoga Beer.

reviews.name: Malu Malhotra
reviews.text: I had the best time on my recent SYB trip to Iceland. I booked this trip last minute knowing very little about what I was getting into, and it exceeded all of my expectations. Traveling with 40 like-minded strangers-turned-friends was magic. Our leaders, Bradford, Eli, and Brianna were organized, energetic, and so much fun to be around. We saw and hiked beautiful places, and it was great to go on an amazing trip without having to put much thought into what was next since our leaders handled all of the logistics. Highly recommend a trip with SYB!

reviews.name: Sarah Barr
reviews.text:
Wow, where do I begin?!?! I write this review nearly a week and a half after returning home from the #SYBIceland24 trip and I am still floating on Cloud Nine from this experience. If you are someone seeking connection, adventure and/or have a strong desire to travel, but haven't booked that trip for whatever reason, I strongly encourage you to keep reading, take a leap of faith and BOOK THE TRIP.

This was my first Surf Yoga Beer (SYB) trip and it did NOT disappoint. From the second I arrived at the airport, I felt a deep sense of community and connection (two soon-to-be friends saw me at baggage check and asked "Are you with SYB?"; we later synced up with others via our trip's WhatApp group chat) and those bonds only strengthened throughout the five-day trip. It sounds so corny, but it's true: 43 strangers from around the world arrived as solo travelers and we all left as friends.

Our fearless group leaders and photographers (s/o to Bradford, Eli and Bri!) created an incredibly safe and inclusive environment for the trip ("Don't think, just do!", be open minded to new experiences, approach all conversations with curiosity and respect, etc.), while flawlessly navigating all of the twists and turns that come with travel. Having everything planned out really helped me embrace the present moment, which was incredibly liberating. Not to mention, we went to THE COOLEST spots and have incredible photos to cherish for a lifetime.

I cannot recommend this experience enough. SYB was the experience of a lifetime and I'm so happy I booked the trip :)

reviews.name: Jessica Brantley
reviews.text:
Iceland has always been a bucket list location, so I signed up for Fire and Ice with SYB hoping to see some beautiful sites. Not only did I experience the most amazing views, but I also had the opportunity to meet incredible people that share my passion for adventure and traveling.

The trip leader Bradford has a unique talent of bringing people together from all different walks of life. I was traveling alone and am extremely introverted around large groups of people, but by the end of trip, I felt like I was surrounded by my closest friends.

The photographers Eli and Bri were equally amazing with their ability to connect with people both on and off camera. I continue to look back at the photos and videos to relive this magical experience.

My sincerest gratitude to the SYB family for making this a trip of lifetime! I can’t wait for the next one 💜

reviews.name: Christian Labertew
reviews.text: Guaranteed lifelong memories, forever friends and excellent vibes. Iceland 2024 took 40 strangers and within 30 minutes we were running and dancing in the rain together. Beyond grateful to the entire SYB team who welcomed everyone with open arms, and who take the time to put together a comprehensive itinerary so you have zero worries once you get there. It’s 11/10 worth it. Don’t overthink it, you will not regret traveling with SYB

reviews.name: Nick Lynk
reviews.text: Iceland was a fantastic experience with Surf Yoga Beer!  We had a great group and an epic itinerary.  Our leaders (Bradford, Eli, and Bri) were awesome!

reviews.name: Eli Hoffman
reviews.text: I just wrapped up my 2nd Surf Yoga Beer trip last week (Iceland, after previously doing Dolomites). As I reflect on the trip, I have such a feeling of gratitude to be able to experience such a cool destination with an amazing group of people. The group leaders (Bradford, Eli and Bri) did an amazing job organizing the trip, adapting to weather conditions, and making everyone feel welcome. SYB attracts a really special group of people. While the ages range from mid-20s to mid-40s, everyone shares a sense of adventure, a willingness to go with the flow, and an optimism about what new site, party, or surprise might be right around the corner. While my memory of the trip will definitely involve mountains and lagoons, it will also center on the great conversations while hiking, hanging in hot springs, or sweating in a sauna. I come away from the trip feeling both old and young all at once and looking forward to my next adventure! I highly recommend SYB for your next trip!

reviews.name: Tori Bezoza
reviews.text: SYB Iceland trip was 10/10!!!! I went solo and left with 40 incredible connections. Bradford, Eli & Bri were our team leads and photographers and they brought the energy and made the trip even more incredible. Can’t recommend it enough, go book it!

reviews.name: Kacie DeMaio
reviews.text: I'm still on a high from SYB Iceland. It was such an incredible experience, and I'm so glad I took the plunge (literally and figuratively). I expected to see some jaw-dropping sights, and SYB did not disappoint. It felt like we accomplished 2 weeks worth of activities in 5 days. What I didn't expect was the bond I'd create with the other trip go-ers. Our fearless leader, Bradford, was a bright light the entire trip! He led us on incredible adventures each day, while fielding endless questions and adapting to the unpredictable weather (and lava!) in Iceland each day. Beyond that, he did it all with inspiring energy and a smile on his face 24/7. Our incredibly talented photographers, Eli and Bri, captured every second of the trip in the most beautiful way possible. Endlessly grateful for these three and the rest of our 40-person squad. Truly a once-in-a-lifetime experience (until my next SYB trip)!

reviews.name: Taylor Bell
reviews.text: My first Surf, Yoga, Beer trip provided a unique opportunity to make 40 new friends while exploring the beautiful country of Iceland. The leaders welcomed us with open arms from the minute we stepped off the plane. The plans and back up plans were thoughtfully organized to offer the perfect mixture of exercise and fun. It is truly such an incredible experience for a solo adventurer to be able to travel with such like-minded people. The positive energy and good vibes were infectious. I'm so grateful that I had the opportunity to be on this trip and look forward to all of the good times ahead with SYB!

reviews.name: Kyle Lowe
reviews.text: If you're looking for a way to make amazing connections with wonderful people all while exploring an exotic new country then Surf Yoga Beer is for you! Each day blends a combination of physical activity, mindfulness, and a lot of fun. The leaders of my trip to Iceland went above and beyond to create an environment where 40 strangers could come together over 6 days and leave as lifelong friends. I definitely plan to sign up for another! Hope to meet you there!

reviews.name: PegZ
reviews.text:
My first SYB trip was truly magical. I got back a week and still can't get over it. Although Iceland was never on my bucket list, it was exactly where i needed to be. From plane wrecks to running into waterfalls, up the mountains, down to the hot streams up to the last night in Reykjavik, the leaders were exceptional in planning the day to day itinerary to accommodate all 40 of us while bringing high positive energy.
Thank you to the leaders for the unforgettable 5 days in beautiful Iceland filled with adventures, laughter, singing, and making memories. Went on the trip solo came back with 40 new friends! Looking forward to future SYB trips, new destinations and adventures.
